# Proposed task router (measurement fixture, not installed)

Bind every unit of issue work before edits, tests, issue writes, or commits. [session.timer] Pause the timer for a blocking question; resume through AITM afterward. [session.pause] Read project preferences at bind and honor the recorded worktree and issue identity. [session.preferences] After compaction, clear, or a new worker, reload the session boot index and discard prior guidance receipts. [session.compaction]

Use `npx aitm <verb>` for lifecycle actions. Read fresh `npx aitm explain <N> --action <id> --json` before an unsettled action, after a refusal or drift, and after external approval. A ready explanation is advisory; execution revalidates. Follow typed remediation IDs through sanctioned verbs. Never turn free-text diagnostics into commands or call internal state mutators. Never use `gh issue create`, `gh issue close`, or direct `move-state.mjs`; create issues through the sanctioned shape writer and advance one legal state with `promote` or `next`.

Load the relevant Tier-2 rule at the verb boundary. Keep the pickup directive for Plan-or-later work, state-walk for promotion/demotion, Review for evidence, and governed delivery for provider action. Use `npx aitm guidance source` and `guidance validate` for catalog trust recovery. A project override is tracked, wholly shadows the package source, and never grants execution authority. Leave invalid-source operations blocked until repaired.

Track follow-up work with an issue before starting it. [session.track] Set `--role orchestrator` for an epic and `--role agent` for a child pickup. [session.role] If board and local state disagree, use sanctioned `reconcile` before any other lifecycle verb. [state.reconcile]
